mandatoryFindings.title: Archive acquisition and physical copying exceed the declared budgets before denial
mandatoryFindings.evidence: Unit.bounded_inventory accounts the pre-open c.info().st_size and ignores the FD metadata returned by c.read; it does not reserve/reconcile actual acquired bytes against the remaining total. Companion Aria actual-function case consumes16 bytes under totalcap10 after same-inode size growth. Separately, Unit.copy_tree invokes literal06 safe_archive_tree/safe_new_copy, whose shutil.copyfileobj reread has no remaining/per-file limit. QA actual-function fake schedule inventories3 bytes then grows that same inode at copy-open;1MiB+1 is already copied under1MiB cap before destination inventory raises ARCHIVE_FILE_CAP_TYPE. Aria independently confirms a total-cap over-copy. No actual archive or filesystem action ran.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Use consumed FD metadata/actual acquisition to bind inventory rows and enforce a remaining aggregate budget before and during every body read. Replace/wrap the inherited unbounded physical copy in a new explicit N-only bounded adapter so per-file/remaining total/expected-length limits apply to the bytes actually read and written, including growth between inventory and open. Revalidate identity/size/hash/modes and exact equality; later HOLD alone cannot undo an over-budget read/copy. Keep source06 immutable, links entry-only, fixed declared limits and no scope enlargement/cleanup/retry. Add focused growth-before-read and growth-before-copy denials preserving all114 semantic cases.

mandatoryFindings.title: A failed prequalification loses the provisional child/client lineage at the guard output boundary
mandatoryFindings.evidence: The actual run/constructor/register fake path times out on its first observation before prequalified. It knows the launched child PID and UNKNOWN partial metadata, retains pending/UNRESOLVED in memory and correctly creates no N records. Static inspection of the exact outer guard shows its failure output contains only status,errorType,credit, then sys.exit(status). It forwards no child/client identity or partial completion facts. In-process references cannot be the durable ownership record after that verification process ends. The actual run path was exercised under fakes; the outer failure sink was inspected statically. No real child/exit/orphan behavior was probed.
mandatoryFindings.requiredCorrection: Preserve and forward closed, explicitly unqualified provisional client/child identity, requested command/executable hash and actual wait/output-completeness/UNKNOWN metadata to the root/operator failure trace before the verification process can end, or retain an actually owned verification process until a separately reviewed disposition. Preserve missing start/full-fingerprint limits; do not invent terminality, backfill later success, kill, retry or write unqualified N facts/markers. The consumed SAME-shell attempt and all failure bytes remain; the next exact disposition must have the finite known partial identities it needs. Add a bounded actual run-to-failure-sink fake composition covering prequalification spawn/timeout/partial failures.
